maya (PM): short sync — define a minimal request/response schema for launch. goals: tiny payloads, explicit token fields, and traceability across systems.

sam (API): thumbs up. Mobile clients ask for flat keys to save parsing cost.

linda (Eng): propose tele_ prefix: tele_prompt_tokens, tele_completion_tokens, tele_cost_micros. server can set tele_total_tokens if omitted.

rahul (ML): use prompt/completion naming to align with model metrics. include emb + emb_dim for embeddings; rank_score + rank_position for rerank.

maya (PM): trace ids: require trace_id as 16-hex (8 bytes) at top level. parent_id and client_request_id optional. doc collision tradeoffs.

noah (DevEx): tool calls: prefer flat suffix keys: tele_tool_0_name, tele_tool_0_status, tele_tool_0_out_bytes. cap N=5 to bound payload. SDKs will map to richer objects.

sam (API): tele_route optional (hosted, dedicated-v2). tele_cost_unit optional; default "micros". server wins on any contradiction.

linda (Eng): gateway will enrich telemetry fields (tokens, cost) so clients can stay minimal. also validate and normalize trace ids.

rahul (ML): add CI checks: token accounting must match prompt+completion within 1 token; monitor rank_score drift.

maya (PM): launch gates: spec document, SDK mappings (py/ts/go), docs + examples, gateway canary, telemetry pipeline updated, 48h canary no regressions.

ops-bot: gateway v1.12 canary window available 2026-04-02T02:00Z.

maya (PM): action items: sam draft spec, noah SDK checklist, linda schedule canary, rahul add tests. reconvene Thu. :rocket:
